name: Barrow Atmospheric Baseline Observatory (BRW)
notes: Established 1973 (GMCC->CMDL->ESRL GMD->GML). Flask CO2 record from 1971-04-25; in-situ CO2/CH4, HATS halocarbons, aerosols (1976-), radiation (1976-), Dobson total ozone (1973-), surface ozone (2003-), meteorology (1973-).

name: BSRN station BAR (Barrow)
notes: Radiation at BRW; first BSRN archive dataset 1992-01-01; closed in BSRN since 2016 (station obstructed) per PANGAEA BSRN wiki. bsrn.awi.de station list unreachable (proxy 502).

name: USGS Barrow Magnetic Observatory (BRW)
notes: Established 1949, upgraded 1957 (IGY), current plant 1975; operated with NOAA GML and BLM. Not in task list; added because it is co-sited with BRW.

name: USCRN Utqiagvik (formerly Barrow) 4 ENE (WBAN 27516)
notes: HOMR period of record begins 2002-08-10; USCRN stations.tsv gives commissioning 2013-07-22 and rounded 71.32/-156.61 (15 ft). GHCN-D USW00027516. About 200 m SSW of BRW.

name: NWS ASOS Wiley Post-Will Rogers Memorial Airport (PABR)
notes: HOMR station BARROW AIRPORT: WBAN 27502, COOP 500546, ICAO PABR, GHCN USW00027502 (GSN). Period of record begins 1901-09-01 (station, not ASOS instrument). Ground 8.1 m, barometer 11.6 m. Relocated 150 ft SE 1955. IEM lists 71.2826/-156.7922 (lower precision, ~2 km W).
coord_precision: 5 dp (~1 m), ASOS CM survey, WGS84

name: NWS Utqiagvik Weather Service Office upper-air site (WMO 70026)
notes: IGRA2 USM00070026, period 1932-2026. Twice-daily radiosondes from the WSO in town. IEM RAOB lists PBRW at 71.3/-156.7 from 1947. WMO 70026 is shared with the airport ASOS in HOMR.

name: NEON Utqiagvik site BARR (site reference point)
network: NEON terrestrial site, Domain D18 Tundra
notes: Gradient (relocatable) terrestrial site inside the BEO. Earliest data product month 2016-05 (megapit); 79 data products. Site host: Ukpeagvik Inupiat Corporation.

name: NEON BARR tower (TOWER104688)

name: Barrow Arctic Research Center (BARC)
notes: Built 2007 on the former NARL campus (NARL Bldg 848). Houses UIC Science offices/labs; supports ~50 projects/yr. EarthScope GNSS BARO roof mount at 71.3250/-156.6677 agrees within ~20 m.

name: Naval Arctic Research Laboratory (NARL), historic
operator: U.S. Office of Naval Research (contract operators incl. University of Alaska from 1954)
notes: Founded Aug 1947 as the Arctic Research Laboratory at the Pet-4 base camp; renamed NARL 1967; Navy withdrew 1980-1981; campus passed to UIC; now hosts Ilisagvik College and BARC. Reed & Ronhovde (1971) give ~71 20 N, 156 46 W (general).

name: Barrow Environmental Observatory (BEO), extent centre
notes: Set aside 1992 (7,466 acres, ~30 km2); NSB Scientific Research District 2003. Bounding box from BAID FeatureServer layer extent: 71.2565-71.3291 N, -156.6664 to -156.4078 E. Polygon query failed (server licence error), so only the bounding box is available.

name: NGEE Arctic Barrow intensive site A soil station
operator: DOE NGEE Arctic (ORNL-led); UAF Permafrost Lab station
notes: Intensive Study Site 1 on the BEO. Transects of 1.5 m vertical thermistor arrays plus 2.5-3 m borehole. Start year from NGEE 2012 vegetation-plot dataset (ORNL DAAC 1505).

name: NGEE Arctic Barrow intensive site B soil station
operator: DOE NGEE Arctic (ORNL-led); UAF Permafrost Lab station
notes: Intensive Study Site 1 on the BEO. Transects of 1.5 m vertical thermistor arrays plus 2.5-3 m borehole. Start year from NGEE 2012 vegetation-plot dataset (ORNL DAAC 1505).

operator: DOE NGEE Arctic (ORNL-led); UAF Permafrost Lab station
notes: Intensive Study Site 1 on the BEO. Transects of 1.5 m vertical thermistor arrays plus 2.5-3 m borehole. Start year from NGEE 2012 vegetation-plot dataset (ORNL DAAC 1505).

name: NGEE Arctic Barrow intensive site D soil station
operator: DOE NGEE Arctic (ORNL-led); UAF Permafrost Lab station
notes: Intensive Study Site 1 on the BEO. Transects of 1.5 m vertical thermistor arrays plus 2.5-3 m borehole. Start year from NGEE 2012 vegetation-plot dataset (ORNL DAAC 1505).

name: CALM grid U1 Barrow (1 km ARCSS/CALM grid)
notes: 11x11 nodes at 100 m. Installed early 1990s, first formal CALM grid; soil climate station U1-1 from June 1995. CALM U2 (CRREL plots, 1962) lies in the SE corner of U1 (no separate coordinates found).

name: UAF Utqiagvik coastal sea-ice radar and webcam
operator: UAF Geophysical Institute Sea Ice Group
notes: X-band marine radar (now 25 kW) atop the 4-storey bank building downtown, range ~10 km; webcam looking N. Radar lineage Mk I 1973-1979, Mk V 2012-present (BOEM talk, Eicken); webcam archive from 2000 (early at NARL). Antenna 22.5 m ASL (Druckenmiller 2011 thesis).

name: UAF Barrow sea-ice mass-balance site (SIZONet MBS)
operator: UAF Geophysical Institute Sea Ice Group
notes: Landfast ice ~1 km offshore N of town (Niksiuraq), ~7 m water; thermistor string, snow/ice sonic and acoustic sea-level gauge. Position re-selected each year; 2007 site is the earliest documented in Druckenmiller et al. (2009).

name: SIZONet mooring B1 (nearshore)
notes: ADCP + CTD + ice-profiling sonar, ~40 m water, ~5 km offshore; deployed 2009-08-04. elev_m is water depth (negative).

name: SIZONet mooring B2 (offshore)
notes: Fukamachi et al. (2017): 71 14.2 N, 157 39.2 W, 55 m water, deployed 2009-08-07. The ADC metadata file lists 156.6571 W, which falls on land and is treated as a typo.

name: NOAA CO-OPS 9494935 Barrow Offshore (water level)
notes: Established 2008-08-13, removed 2010-08-20; tidal datums on 1983-2001 epoch; chart 16082.

name: NOAA CO-OPS 9495048 Point Barrow (tide predictions)
notes: Subordinate tide-prediction station referenced to 9457292; no gauge.

name: AERONET Barrow sun photometer
operator: NASA GSFC AERONET; site PI at DOE Brookhaven National Laboratory
notes: Data years 1997-2026 (~29 years operational time). Listed position is ~2 km WSW of ARM C1/BRW; treat as AERONET-registered location. NEON BARR also runs a spectral sun photometer (DP1.00043.001, 2017-).

name: EarthScope GNSS SG27 (NOTA/PBO)
notes: Deep-foundation mast near BRW; sessions 2002-05-04 to 2026-09-10; met pack MET3. Ellipsoidal height field unreliable in the service output, so elev_m left blank.

name: EarthScope GNSS BARO (Barrow Arctic Research Center roof)
notes: Building roof; sessions 2014-04-17 to 2023-09-09.

name: EarthScope GNSS BASC (Barrow community base station)
notes: Building wall; sessions 2011-12-21 to 2015-03-02.

name: Utqiagvik (formerly Barrow), city
operator: City of Utqiagvik / North Slope Borough seat
notes: 2020 Census population 4,927 (Alaska DOLWD; Wikidata gives 4,928); 4,212 in 2010. Land 48.6 km2, water 7.0 km2. Incorporated as Barrow 1958; renamed Utqiagvik by referendum Oct 2016, effective 2016-12-01. Downtown is near 71.2925 N, 156.788 W (radar building).

name: Point Barrow (Nuvuk)
notes: Northernmost point of the USA; divides Chukchi and Beaufort Seas. Nuvuk, the Inupiat settlement/archaeological site at the point, was occupied ~1,000 years until the 1940s (Thule burials and artefacts). Spit position migrates with erosion.

name: Point Barrow Long Range Radar Site (DEW Line POW-Main, LRR A-17)
notes: Context only, not a research asset. DEW main site from 1955 with separate airstrip; between NARL and BRW.
